_description: xhttptunnel Split-HTTP / Meek Streaming Client Configuration. The psk below is a placeholder that the binary refuses to run with; replace it with the server's secret, or let scripts/install.sh resolve it.

_fields.listen: Local TCP listening address for applications to connect to (e.g. tcp://127.0.0.1:1080)
_fields.server: Remote xhttptunnel server streaming URL (e.g. https://example.com:8443/stream)
_fields.target: Target backend service to connect through the tunnel (e.g. 127.0.0.1:22). Alias: forward
_fields.psk: Pre-shared key matching the server. It is never sent: each request carries a fresh nonce plus its HMAC-SHA256 over the nonce, session id and target, so a captured request leaks nothing and cannot be replayed or retargeted. Aliases: token, auth_token. Empty = connect unauthenticated.
_fields.sni: Optional TLS SNI disguise/domain (default: inherited from the server URL domain. Required if the server URL uses a CDN IP)
_fields.host: Optional HTTP Host disguise/domain (default: inherited from the server URL domain. Required if the server URL uses a CDN IP)
_fields.alpn: HTTP protocol selection: 'auto' (probe HTTP/3, fall back), 'h3', 'h2', or 'h1'
_fields.stream_mode: Downlink transport: 'auto' (negotiate), 'poll' (legacy long-poll), or 'stream' (force streaming). Invalid values fail startup.
_fields.fingerprint: SHA256 certificate pin of the server certificate (required for self-signed TLS; empty uses the system CA roots plus SNI hostname verification, which is appropriate for ordinary CDN HTTPS)
_fields.cert: Optional path to the server's TLS certificate. Client mode does not read it; it is used only by the gen-uri command to derive the fingerprint pin above.
_fields.key: Optional path to the server's TLS private key. Not used by the client at all.
_fields.chunk_size_kb: Caps the upstream payload carried by one poll request (clamped 16-900, default 256). Must match the server value; raise on BOTH ends together.
_fields.idle_timeout: Drop a local connection after this many seconds without traffic (default 900). Idle SSH sessions need a keepalive below it.
_fields.max_conns: Maximum concurrent client connections allowed (0 = default 2000)
_fields.brutal: TCP Brutal (Linux kernel module only; inert on other platforms). Caps the send rate of this client's TCP tunnel sockets in bytes/s. HTTP/3 tunnels run over QUIC/UDP and are never capped. Nested object: enabled (default false; off means setsockopt is never called), rate (bytes/s ceiling; 0 is illegal unless bw_exchange supplies one), cwnd_gain (tenths, so 20 = 2.0x; 0 = default 20, max 100), group_id (0 = per-connection only), bw_exchange (enable the _BrutalBwExchange protocol), bw_advertise (bytes/s this client can ingest; the server applies it as its own send rate), bw_interval (seconds between exchange attempts, default 60). The rate is a ceiling: the exchange can only lower it. A socket failure never breaks a tunnel: the connection continues uncapped and the failure is logged once.
_fields.dump: Dump raw packet hex data in logs for low-level debugging
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
